arabic: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ
translation: And when your Lord proclaimed: If ye give thanks, I will give you more; but if ye are thankless, lo! My punishment is dire.
transliteration: La'in shakartum la'azīdannakum

arabic: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا
translation: Say: O My slaves who have been prodigal to their own hurt! Despair not of the mercy of Allah, Who forgiveth all sins. Lo! He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
transliteration: Qul yā ʿibādiya alladhīna asrafū ʿalā anfusihim, lā taqnaṭū min raḥmati Allāh; inna Allāha yaghfiru adh-dhunūba jamīʿā

arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
translation: Therefore remember Me, I will remember you. Give thanks to Me, and reject not Me.
transliteration: Fadhkurūnī adhkurkum, washkurū lī wa lā takfurūn

arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation: Lo! with hardship goeth ease;
transliteration: Fa-inna maʿa al-ʿusri yusrā

arabic: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
translation: Who have believed and whose hearts have rest in the remembrance of Allah. Verily in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest!
transliteration: Alā bidhikri Allāhi taṭmaʾinnu al-qulūb

arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
translation: And will provide for him from (a quarter) whence he hath no expectation. And whosoever putteth his trust in Allah, He will suffice him. Lo! Allah bringeth His command to pass. Allah hath set a measure for all things.
transliteration: Wa man yatawakkal ʿalā Allāhi fahuwa ḥasbuh

arabic: إِن يَنصُرْكُمُ اللَّهُ فَلَا غَالِبَ لَكُمْ
translation: If Allah is your helper none can overcome you, and if He withdraw His help from you, who is there who can help you after Him? In Allah let believers put their trust.
transliteration: In yanṣurkumu Allāhu falā ghāliba lakum

arabic: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ
translation: And your Lord hath said: Pray unto Me and I will hear your prayer. Lo! those who scorn My service, they will enter hell, disgraced.
transliteration: Wa qāla rabbukumu adʿūnī astajib lakum

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
translation: O ye who believe! Seek help in steadfastness and prayer. Lo! Allah is with the steadfast.
transliteration: Yā ayyuhā alladhīna āmanū istaʿīnū biṣ-ṣabri waṣ-ṣalāh; inna Allāha maʿa aṣ-ṣābirīn

arabic: وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا
translation: As for those who strive in Us, We surely guide them to Our paths, and lo! Allah is with the good.
transliteration: Wa alladhīna jāhadū fīnā lanahdiyannahum subulanā

arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
transliteration: Fabi-ayyi ālāʾi rabbikumā tukadhdhibān

arabic: وَلَا تَهِنُوا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation: Faint not nor grieve, for ye will overcome them if ye are (indeed) believers.
transliteration: Wa lā tahinū wa lā taḥzanū wa antumu al-aʿlawna in kuntum muʾminīn

arabic: قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَا إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَنَا
translation: Say: Naught befalleth us save that which Allah hath decreed for us. He is our Protecting Friend. In Allah let believers put their trust!
transliteration: Qul lan yuṣībanā illā mā kataba Allāhu lanā

arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ سُوءًا أَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهُ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ يَجِدِ اللَّهَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
translation: Yet whoso doeth evil or wrongeth his own soul, then seeketh pardon of Allah, will find Allah Forgiving, Merciful.
transliteration: Wa man yaʿmal sūʾan aw yaẓlim nafsahū thumma yastaghfiri Allāha yajidi Allāha ghafūran raḥīmā

arabic: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ
translation: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
transliteration: Wa naḥnu aqrabu ilayhi min ḥabli al-warīd

arabic: وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ
translation: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days; then He mounted the Throne. He knoweth all that entereth the earth and all that emergeth therefrom and all that cometh down from the sky and all that ascendeth therein; and He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.
transliteration: Wa huwa maʿakum ayna mā kuntum

arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَا ۖ إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَا أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
translation: He said: Fear not. Lo! I am with you twain, Hearing and Seeing.
transliteration: Qāla lā takhāfā; innanī maʿakumā asmaʿu wa arā

arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
translation: And when My servants question thee concerning Me, then surely I am nigh. I answer the prayer of the suppliant when he crieth unto Me. So let them hear My call and let them trust in Me, in order that they may be led aright.
transliteration: Wa idhā saʾalaka ʿibādī ʿannī fa-innī qarīb; ujību daʿwata ad-dāʿi idhā daʿān

arabic: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَارْغَب
translation: And strive to please thy Lord.
transliteration: Wa ilā rabbika farghab

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ
translation: O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah with right observance, and die not save as those who have surrendered (unto Him)
transliteration: Yā ayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ittaqū Allāha ḥaqqa tuqātih

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلْتَنظُرْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍ
translation: O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah. And let every soul look to that which it sendeth on before for the morrow. And observe your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Informed of what ye do.
transliteration: Yā ayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ittaqū Allāh; waltanẓur nafsun mā qaddamat lighad

arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ
translation: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then,
transliteration: Faman yaʿmal mithqāla dharratin khayran yarah

arabic: الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا
translation: Who hath created life and death that He may try you which of you is best in conduct; and He is the Mighty, the Forgiving,
transliteration: Alladhī khalaqa al-mawta wa al-ḥayāta liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalā

arabic: إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِّنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation: Work not confusion in the earth after the fair ordering (thereof). and call on Him in fear and hope. Lo! the mercy of Allah is nigh unto the good.
transliteration: Inna raḥmata Allāhi qarībun mina al-muḥsinīn

arabic: نَبِّئْ عِبَادِي أَنِّي أَنَا الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
translation: Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves that verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
transliteration: Nabbiʾ ʿibādī annī anā al-ghafūru ar-raḥīm
